title: hoita glandulosa
intro: Hoita glandulosa, commonly known as Hoja de Venado, is a plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family, native to the Andean region of South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hoita glandulosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Hoita glandulosa include volatile oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
